answer: Give every agent one verified mobile number, re-checked weekly. A new agent submits its number, gets a one-time code from a real carrier, and pays $1 per weekly re-check. A Sybil farm needs one live SIM per fake: 1,000 fakes cost $3,000 in SIMs at $3 each plus $1,000 a week to stay alive. Resellers in a tundra of grey-market stalls cap each buyer at 20 numbers a month, so one attacker needs 50 suppliers and months of work. At the nadir, a recycled number still traces to a carrier bill, and ocean-wide the cost grows with every fake: $7,000 in month one alone.
